Why native plants?
The local plants co-evolved with the local insects/birds/etc to make an ecosystem. Oak trees are a host plant for 150+ butterflies/moths, which start out as caterpillars, otherwise known as bird food. A nest of baby birds needs 600-900 worms to eat. A non-native plant hosts 0 insects, starving the birds. The bees like them too.
